Hi Samir / Leah,

Great to meet today — appreciate you walking me through Altair's content indexing and customer support pipeline. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we have alignment:

What we heard
- Primary use case: real-time semantic search over product docs + AI-assisted ticket summarization for L2 agents.
- Traffic profile: ~5000 support conversations/day, average session length 600-800 tokens.
- Success criteria: sub-100ms 95th percentile for autocomplete/search, 30% reduction in agent handle time for summarized tickets, and no PII leakage.
- Timeline: exploring pilot in Q3; procurement window target end of July.

What Redwood can help with
- Hosted API for rapid PoC; option to move to Dedicated if throughput requires it.
- Built-in prefix KV caching to reduce per-token cost for repeated queries.
- SOC2/audit evidence and private deployment options for the procurement checklist.

Next steps (proposed)
1) I've attached my discovery notes and a preliminary pricing estimate for a 6-week pilot (attachment).
2) If you're comfortable, we can schedule a 30-min technical demo + pilot plan with Dylan next week to walk through integration and sample latency numbers.
3) If procurement needs paperwork, I can send our standard security/compliance package and an SOW draft.

Would love to lock a time for the demo — are you available Tues 6/30 or Wed 7/1 afternoon PT? If those don't work, tell me the best window and we'll adapt.

Thanks again — excited about the fit here.

Best,
